features.name: Versatile

effects.note: Humans have no racial traits. They instead gain one point in every ability score, one extra skill proficiency, and a bonus feat at character creation. The only humanoid race able to do this.

features.summary: Gain 1 in every ability, one extra skill, and a bonus feat
features.text: Ability Score Increase. Humans are the most adaptable and opportunistic of all the races. While any race can become what they need to be, humans are exceptionally capable of adapting to any sort of challenge, from scaling a wall of ice to slaying a frost giant with little more than mild sarcasm. Humans are the most widespread and adaptable of all the races. They are said to have short lives, but they leave behind a legacy that lasts forever. While humans have short lives, they have a remarkable ability to achieve great things in the time they have. Humans are the only race that can increase every one of their six ability scores by one point. They also gain an extra skill proficiency and a bonus feat at character creation.

When you cast any spell of 2nd level or higher, the lights merge into one light that changes colour to match the spell. When the feature ends, the lights disappear if they have not already been dismissed.

features.name: Tinker

effects.note: You know the mending cantrip and can cast it at any level, without a spell slot, once per long rest when you finish a short rest. You also know the rules for crafting and operating a simple mechanical device, so you can spend time and raw materials to improvise a simple device. The device must be in a category that you have knowledge of and it must be no larger than 1 foot in any dimension. You decide what it does if you are the first to craft it, and the GM has the same right. The device has no moving parts and is obviously magical to anyone who handles it. It is a temporary use, lasting for 1 hour.
